Whether resonance produces finitely many points or complete families of periodic orbits, and the total size of those families, are structural dynamical questions that affect periodic-orbit statistics and the exact geometry of the nonhyperbolic obstruction. The complete six-component primitive-three census, paired twelve-piece itinerary geometry, and three distinct metric lengths, and explicit Hausdorff 1-measure are motivated invariant information not implied by the reported mixing windows or hyperbolicity boundary.
